content.short: Discover Giza, a highly optimized Zero Knowledge Tools protocol focusing on zk developer tools to drive mass adoption in Web3.
content.description: Giza is a protocol for zero-knowledge machine learning. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Giza provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on zk developer tools. By operating on Starknet and Ethereum, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the Zero Knowledge Tools sector. Through continuous innovation, Giza contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
content.meta: Explore Giza, a powerful Zero Knowledge Tools protocol built on Starknet and others. Enhance your decentralized workflow with Giza on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
